title: Add a Performance Regression Gate to the Pipeline
objective: Turn a load test into an automated CI check that fails when a change regresses latency or error rate beyond a stated margin.
whyThisMatters: A load test that only runs manually before a big release catches regressions too late and too rarely. A gate in the pipeline catches them at the commit that introduced them.
evidence: The CI job configuration for the performance gate
Pipeline log or output showing the gate failing on a deliberate regression
Pipeline log or output showing the gate passing after the regression is reverted
A written note on how CI noise/variance was accounted for
acceptanceCriteria: The CI configuration runs the load test and compares the result to a stored baseline, not an arbitrary hardcoded number picked without justification.
A deliberately introduced regression is shown failing the gate, with the pipeline output captured.
The pipeline is shown passing again once the regression is reverted.
The noise/variance-handling approach is documented, naming the specific margin or iteration count chosen.
